name: Ruy López — Morphy Defense Closed
description: The most important Ruy López line. After 3...a6 4.Ba4 Nf6, White castles and plays Re1 to support the e4-pawn before Black can equalize. The Closed variation is where the deepest theoretical battles of the Spanish Opening unfold.

lines.name: Morphy Defense — Closed Main Line
lines.description: White develops rapidly, castles, and supports the e4-pawn with Re1. Black plays b5 to kick the bishop, then d6 to solidify the center. After 8.c3 O-O, the classic Ruy López middlegame is reached — White prepares d4 while Black seeks queenside counter-play.
